newsitem.title: UK: Bank of England executive to join Nomura International.
newsitem.headline: Bank of England executive to join Nomura International.

text.p: Nomura Bank International Plc on Tuesday said Brian Quinn would join the company as non-executive chairman on September 1.

Quinn, 59, who has spent more than 20 years at the Bank of England, most recently as Executive Director for Supervision and Surveillance, will serve jointly with Andreas Prindl, who has been chairman since 1989, until Prindl retires in early 1997.
Before joining the Bank, Quinn was an economist in the African Department of the International Monetary Fund. His other directorships include Bankgesellschaft Berlin (UK) Plc and Celtic Plc.
